name: GatherOS
soft_passes: #2 glyph sized generously — crowds safe-zone margins but stays inside; optically centered
#3 silhouette holds as one bold mass with a counter, but subject is an ambiguous letterform (reads D/G), not instantly nameable as an object
#6 frosted body is one neutral, but prismatic dispersion adds 3 desaturated hues (blue/violet/warm) — one glass material, not competing accents
#10 glyph is luminance-driven so robust to tinting, but dark field + dispersion are baked; true light/clear/tinted layer behavior unverifiable at 204px
light_model: Environmental Liquid-Glass: top-left key drives bg ramp (#3E3E3E TL -> #030303 BR) and specular catches on upper/left glass edges (#C4C8CB-#D8DCDD); short soft baked inner-shadow in the counter; prismatic chromatic dispersion stands in for a colored bounce light
devices: prismatic glass dispersion (chromatic aberration across a frosted letterform)
dark full-bleed field with diagonal top-left light (inverts Big Sur light-sky ramp)
bold rounded monogram with counter + side-notch (same mark as the app wordmark: logo-as-icon)
rhymes_hint: dark-glass monogram family — current-era utility icons rendering a single frosted-glass glyph on a near-black field with baked specular + chromatic dispersion (Raycast-adjacent dark glass, Arc-ish glass marks); style guess 'glass monogram on charcoal'
notes: Source is a 204x204 web render, below Dock/@2x resolution — specular/dispersion read from an upscale; cannot confirm whether glass effects are Icon Composer system-applied vs baked into the artwork. Squint tests (downscaled) hold: bold mass + counter survive at 16px, notch and faint tints return by 32px, high figure-ground contrast throughout. Subject-communication miss: app is a design-inspiration/moodboard tool but the icon is an abstract monogram that depicts brand, not function (logo-as-icon; same mark appears as the app wordmark in cover.png). Palette coherence: dark field + single prismatic moment coheres with the app's black/white brand while iridescence rhymes with its colorful inspiration thumbnails. Presented as a standard system squircle in cover.png (no mask-fighting).
